verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the 'See the Flavours' CTA sits above the headline and is pushed off-centre to the right. The LIMITED badge has also drifted away from the CTA into the top-right, so the top cluster looks random, though the larger three-line headline fills the square better. B keeps the original grouping and order (headline, then the badge with the CTA) and stays on brand. However, it is the landscape block pasted unchanged into the middle of the square, with nothing rearranged: the headline is undersized for the canvas, there is dead orange space above and below, and the CTA still sits off the headline's centre axis as in the original.
